housing.text: Supported AB 2058, which would streamline inspections and permitting for factory-built housing to reduce costs and increase housing production.
housing.quote: AB 2058 takes a practical step toward addressing California's housing shortage by modernizing rules for factory built housing.

abortion.text: Honored a Planned Parenthood leader and was described as a partner in expanding access to safe and legal abortion and other health services.
abortion.quote: I look forward to continuing my work in advocacy and partnering with champions like Assemblymember Harabedian to expand access to safe and legal abortion and other essential health services in California,

energy.text: As a Sierra Madre councilmember, he led a solar-energy initiative and helped create the Clean Power Alliance to promote renewable energy.
energy.quote: He led Sierra Madre’s groundbreaking solar energy initiative, which now powers the city, and co-founded the Clean Power Alliance to promote renewable energy across the region.
